baseline_models.focus_anchor: الحق at word 5 opposed to الباطل at word 11 within three repeated assertions.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse sets worship-worthy divinity, reality that corresponds and persists, and falsehood that loses standing into a single ontological contrast.

activation_trace.role: Supplies worship and the worshipped one, making the repeated divine name the contrast's cultic pole.
Supplies correspondence with what is fixed, functioning as the positive pole of durable reality.
Supplies departure from truth and loss of persistence, functioning as the negative pole.
Supplies otherness and lesser rank, locating the negative pole among substitutes besides God.

changed_reading.before: Truth and falsehood are opposing labels.
changed_reading.after: The sentence contrasts the one worship-worthy reality that stands with substitutes whose apparent standing does not persist.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يدعون at word 8, من دونه at words 9-10, and الحق/الباطل at words 5 and 11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling can also be claiming or affiliating; haqq can be an owned due under contest, while batil can be an assertion without reality. The verse therefore reads as adjudication of rival claims to worship and allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Supplies assertion of a right or affiliation, turning invocation into a rival claim.
Supplies a specific due held by its owner, functioning as the rightful claim to worship.
Supplies a contest in which each side alleges right, making the contrast judicial rather than merely descriptive.
Supplies an unfounded assertion, functioning as the adverse claim that fails adjudication.
Supplies an alternative of lesser rank, identifying the rival claimants without granting parity.

changed_reading.before: People invoke false objects besides God.
changed_reading.after: People advance rival affiliations and claims to worship; the verse rules that the due belongs to God and the adverse claims lack title.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: من دونه at word 10 answered by العلي الكبير at words 15-16.
baseline_models.mechanism: A vertical image coexists with a rank reading: substitutes stop short and remain below, while divine height is dominance and deserved majesty, not merely altitude.

activation_trace.role: Supplies nearness below a limit or failure to reach a goal, placing substitutes short of ultimacy.
Supplies literal elevation, preserving the verse's live vertical image.
Supplies mastery and prevailing power, converting height into sovereign rank.
Supplies greatness and rightful majesty, completing the superiority claim without requiring bodily size.

changed_reading.before: The final names say that God is high and large.
changed_reading.after: The closing pair answers 'besides/below' with unattained sovereign rank and rightful greatness, while leaving spatial imagery secondary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening book sequence activates haqq as tightly joined, finished discourse: truth is not only correspondence but coherence whose parts hold together.

activation_trace.role: Supplies firm weaving in speech, furnishing the focus anchor for discursive coherence.
Supplies joining one element to another, making the book a composed whole rather than isolated signs.
Supplies perfected firmness and reliability, functioning as the seal on that joined whole.

structural_cues: 31:2 places signs, book, and wisdom in one compact nominal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining and perfected firmness; I infer that al-Haqq can name the coherence that holds revelation together. A live alternative is that these cues characterize only the book, not the divine name.

changed_reading.before: Al-Haqq names reality corresponding to fact.
changed_reading.after: Al-Haqq can also be heard as the reliable coherence in which signs and discourse are fitted into a firm whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human self-enlargement appears as refusal, swagger, boasting, and excessive sonic presence; measured gait and voice reverse it. Divine kabir therefore exposes counterfeit scale rather than merely exceeding it.

activation_trace.role: Supplies prevailing rank, grounding greatness in sovereignty rather than performance.
Supplies both self-exaltation and rightful divine majesty, enabling the contrast between counterfeit and deserved greatness.
Supplies human self-exaltation in the listener's refusal, functioning as the counterfeit form.
Supplies conceited display in walking, embodying inflated scale.
Supplies competitive boasting, adding a social performance of largeness.
Supplies moderation between extremes, functioning as the bodily correction to inflation.
Supplies audible voice, whose commanded reduction turns sonic size into an ethical measure.

structural_cues: 31:7 turns away in self-exaltation; 31:18-19 opposes swagger and boasting with measured gait and lowered voice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two kinds of enlargement and an explicit moderation sequence; I infer that the divine title calibrates true scale against human inflation. Alternatively, the ethical commands may only contrast creaturely vice with a divine attribute.

changed_reading.after: Al-Kabir also unmasks noisy, bodily, and social self-enlargement as a counterfeit of greatness grounded in sovereign rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: Haqq is tested across time as a promise that arrives, while batil can still offer brief benefit and glitter. Falsehood is not simple nonexistence; it is attractive but non-enduring performance failure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies binding necessity and fixed entitlement, allowing truth to function as enforceable commitment.
Supplies loss of persistence, defining the rival pole by failure to endure.
Supplies a spoken promise that opens expectation, furnishing the commitment to be tested.
Supplies binding realization beside the promise, marking it as more than hopeful speech.
Supplies real temporary benefit and enjoyment, preventing falsehood from being reduced to experiential nothingness.
Supplies smallness and brevity, limiting that benefit's temporal reach.
Supplies the repeated future-facing commitment immediately declared reliable.
Supplies fixed obligation, turning the repeated promise into assured performance.
Supplies deception by something that flashes but does not hold, giving batil an attractive temporal mechanism.

structural_cues: 31:9 and 31:33 each directly pair promise with haqq; 31:24 inserts a short enjoyment before compulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated promise-truth pairings, brief enjoyment, and unstable glitter; I infer that duration and fulfilled commitment test the poles in 31:30. Alternatively, haqq may only intensify each promise locally.

changed_reading.before: Truth is static reality and falsehood is absent reality.
changed_reading.after: Truth is reliability that performs across delay, whereas falsehood may be vividly useful or alluring for a while yet fail to complete what it seems to promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, stabilization, growth, the failed rival-creation challenge, and the reliable grip form a load-bearing test: haqq produces and supports; batil is active-looking but functionally idle.

activation_trace.role: Supplies firmly made structure, anchoring the focus in load-bearing coherence.
Supplies idleness and loss of useful work, functioning as operational rather than merely verbal falsehood.
Supplies origination, making productive efficacy the first material test.
Supplies firm settling, functioning as resistance to destabilizing motion.
Supplies sway and disturbance, identifying the instability that the fixed order checks.
Supplies emergence of growth from earth, adding generative fruit to structural support.
Supplies creation on both sides of the challenge, exposing the alternatives' absent output.
Supplies what remains below the goal, casting rival agency as causally short of the required threshold.
Supplies holding fast, translating reliable reality into an act of dependence.
Supplies firm fastening, making that dependence load-bearing rather than affective alone.

structural_cues: 31:11 explicitly asks for the alternatives' created output.
The handhold root at 31:22 has no branch inventory and is used only as structural imagery connecting grip and firmness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origination, stabilization, growth, failed rival production, grip, and fastening; I infer one efficacy-and-reliance test. A live alternative is that creation and the handhold are separate proofs with no shared material model.

changed_reading.before: Al-Haqq is correct and al-batil is incorrect.
changed_reading.after: Al-Haqq is a productive, stabilizing order on which action can bear weight; al-batil is exposed by failure to create, support, or provide a reliable hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's rival-claim reading becomes a hierarchy of dues: parental claims retain gratitude, companionship, and recognized good, but cannot share or replace the ultimate claim; at judgment even the closest kin cannot stand in another's place.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a due held by an owner, grounding the model in differentiated claims.
Supplies lesser rank short of the ultimate limit, allowing subordinate claims without parity.
Supplies shared participation, identifying the prohibited transfer of the ultimate claim.
Supplies an entrusted directive carried to another, establishing a real relational obligation.
Supplies recognition of benefit and its giver, preserving the parents' acknowledged due.
Supplies obedience, whose negation marks the boundary of parental authority.
Supplies continuing companionship, preserving social duty after cultic obedience is refused.
Supplies conduct recognized as good, regulating that continued companionship.
Supplies one thing standing in another's place, whose negation makes ultimate liability nontransferable.
Supplies the closest generational relation, making failed substitution maximally strong.

structural_cues: 31:14-15 preserves gratitude and good companionship while refusing obedience in partnership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded obedience, preserved companionship, and failed kin substitution; I infer an ordered rights system in which only the ultimate claim is nonshareable. Alternatively, the family rules may illustrate accountability without defining haqq.

changed_reading.before: Everything besides God is simply excluded.
changed_reading.after: The verse excludes parity and proxy, not subordinate human dues: real claims are ranked, while worship and final liability cannot be shared or transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: A minute item enclosed in rock and inward blessings remain real and knowable. This blocks a visual simplification in which batil means merely unseen; its defect is instability or failed claim, not hiddenness.

activation_trace.role: Supplies correspondence with fixed reality, independent of whether that reality is visible.
Supplies loss of truth and persistence, distinguishing falsehood from simple concealment.
Supplies massive solidity, functioning as an extreme container of what remains real while hidden.
Supplies minuteness, subtlety, and concealment, keeping tiny hidden reality within divine reach.
Supplies knowledge of an affair's interior, making concealment epistemically penetrable.
Supplies an affair's inward hidden aspect, explicitly placing hidden benefit on the real side.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests a minute item inside rock, heavens, or earth and says it is brought forth.
31:20 coordinates outward and inward blessings under one act of bestowal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden but effective realities; I infer the negative distinction that visibility cannot divide haqq from batil. Alternatively, the passages concern divine knowledge and benefit without revising the ontology of 31:30.

changed_reading.before: The real is manifest and the false lacks reality because it is not seen.
changed_reading.after: Hiddenness is compatible with full reality; batil is better located in failed persistence, efficacy, or title than in invisibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling is a social and affective circuit: inherited following answers a destructive counter-call, while engulfing danger strips mixture and redirects invocation exclusively to God; rescue then tests whether that disclosed orientation persists.

activation_trace.role: Supplies vocal calling and attraction toward an object, anchoring invocation as directed orientation.
Supplies alternative orientation, identifying the rival termini of the calls.
Supplies going after another, turning inherited religion into a response pathway.
Supplies the rebellious counter-agent who occupies the caller role.
Supplies an attracting call directed at the followers, reversing them from callers into recipients.
Supplies an overlying cover, making danger an encompassing test rather than a distant idea.
Supplies interpenetrating disturbance, destabilizing ordinary divided allegiance.
Supplies the crisis call now directed to God, providing the focus root's contrasting object.
Supplies exclusive separation from partnership, functioning as purification of orientation.
Supplies obedience and submission, showing that the call carries allegiance rather than sound alone.
Supplies rescue by separation, ending the pressure that exposed exclusive orientation.
Supplies treacherous failure to fulfill, explaining post-rescue reversion as broken allegiance.

structural_cues: 31:21 makes inherited followers the objects of a call; 31:32 makes the same root an exclusive call to God.
31:32 sequences engulfment, exclusive invocation, rescue, partial moderation, and denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite call directions and a pressure-release sequence; I infer that crisis acts as an assay of latent allegiance and that batil operates through a call-follow loop. Alternatively, emergency prayer may be situational behavior rather than disclosure of a deeper orientation.

changed_reading.before: The focus classifies the objects that worshippers verbally invoke.
changed_reading.after: The focus also diagnoses a reversible orientation system: people are called, follow, call alternatives, and under pressure disclose an exclusive allegiance that may or may not survive rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inexhaustible words, mass creation handled as one self, and nested celestial cycles under subjection and term detach greatness from quantity and height from location. The closing titles name scale-independent governance of changing processes.

activation_trace.role: Supplies firmly ordered structure, allowing changing processes to remain a coherent real order.
Supplies mastery and prevailing power, grounding height in governance over the cycles.
Supplies quantitative magnitude, which the context activates only to exceed and revise.
Supplies rightful majesty, carrying greatness after quantitative scale is collapsed.
Supplies exhaustion and ending under negation, making divine discourse exceed accumulation.
Supplies meaningful verbal units, the indefinitely multiplied domain that does not exhaust.
Supplies origination of the many, one side of the explicit scale collapse.
Supplies raising what is still, extending the scale collapse to re-creation.
Supplies numerical oneness, making the many no harder than one.
Supplies entry of one thing inside another, rendering cosmic order nested and processual.
Supplies directed subjection to a purpose, locating sovereignty above the celestial agents' motion.
Supplies flowing motion, making the governed order dynamic rather than static.
Supplies a fixed temporal limit, giving the motion a governed horizon.

structural_cues: 31:27 multiplies writing media without exhausting divine words; 31:28 equates the creation and raising of the many with one self.
Immediately before the focus, 31:29 interleaves night and day and subjects sun and moon to named terms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit quantity collapse and governed celestial process; I infer that al-Kabir is nonquantitative majesty and al-Ali sovereign rank rather than a location inside the sky. Alternatively, the signs may only evidence the titles while ordinary magnitude and height remain primary images.

changed_reading.before: God is the largest and physically highest being in a stable hierarchy.
changed_reading.after: The titles name sovereignty invariant across number, duration, and celestial height: changing systems run within limits, while divine greatness is not one measurable item among them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the focus call-root to a forceful-pressure image rather than the morphologically near vocal-call inventory. It remains anchored in يدعون and gains support from the call/follow reversal in 31:21, but downstream prose should render it only as a pressure-like social mechanism, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يدعون at word 8 through its packet-supplied non-dominant mapped inventory.

activation_trace.role: Supplies forceful displacement, functioning exploratorily as pressure exerted by a false invocation system.
Supplies failure to retain standing, containing the pressure system on the false side of the focus contrast.
Supplies the same forceful image at the counter-call, making the social pressure directional.
Supplies allegiance and succession, providing the chain through which pressure propagates.

changed_reading.before: Worshippers freely direct calls toward false objects.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a false call can be carried as social pressure that pushes allegiance through an inherited following chain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because a penetrating-thrust image is transferred from haqq to the retrieval of a minute concealed item. It remains anchored in the focus haqq branch and the packet's rock/subtlety sequence at 31:16, but downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for truth reaching concealment, not as the surface meaning of al-Haqq.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الحق at word 5 activated through its straight-penetration branch.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a straight penetration that reaches within, functioning as an exploratory image of truth traversing concealment.
Supplies massive solidity, furnishing the resistant enclosure through which retrieval is imagined.
Supplies minuteness and hidden subtlety, furnishing the concealed target that remains reachable.

changed_reading.before: Truth corresponds to a reality once disclosed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, truth has reach: even what is minute and enclosed can be brought through concealment into exact account.

strongest_changes: Batil became an attractive but non-enduring, causally idle substitute rather than simple nonexistence.
Al-Haqq became performed reliability and a load-bearing order that creates, stabilizes, and can be held to.
Invocation became a reversible call-follow orientation whose exclusivity is exposed under pressure.
Al-Ali al-Kabir shifted from spatial and quantitative superlatives toward scale-independent sovereign rank.
Ultimate worship and liability became nonshareable and nontransferable without erasing subordinate human dues.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converted nominal contrasts into tests: promise across delay, output under a creation challenge, grip under reliance, allegiance under a wave, and scale under inexhaustibility. These activations preserve ontological, juridical, operational, social, temporal, and exploratory material readings without merging them.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ذلك points narrowly to the immediately preceding celestial process or gathers the wider sequence.
Whether the material fit, grip, pressure, and penetration branches are semantic activations or only reader-supplied analogies.
Whether haqq in the repeated promise formulas defines the divine title or locally confirms those promises.
The ontological, rights-based, and process-governance readings remain live together and are not disambiguated.
